Postscript:

Hello everyone! :)

This is the final update where all additions come to an end! This is great news, especially because now the music provides the appropriate atmosphere for each location!
There may be future updates with gameplay adjustments, but the current state of the game is likely balanced with Sutelz's strength. From the very beginning, all enemy stats were created based on Sutelz’s to ensure that, depending on what is done (and maybe with a bit of luck...), Sutelz becomes practically invincible in this game. She is truly strong!

Thus, the remaining updates will focus on reviewing languages that have not yet been proofread by a person and adding more languages.

Honestly, I no longer have money to invest in this game. Around 12,000 reais have been spent on it, so please understand that I cannot complete it immediately. This will be done with the earnings.

Thank you so much to everyone who has read this far, and let’s hope for better days ahead in Sutelz’s life!!✨

notes.title: Big News!
notes.notes:
Hello, today's important news.

At first, the game was called “Kimi sae Ireba Episode Sutelz”, and some people may not know it, but it's from a Japanese source. After rethinking it, I decided it was better to name the game in English here on the Steam store, for clear and simple reasons, which is to make the game as memorable as possible.
The previous name, “Kimi sae Ireba Episode Sutelz” has the meaning of “If only you were here - Episode Sutelz”, but the current name is different from that, and this is due to the meaning that the title can give. I think many people have seen something similar, so this is the version that retains the original meaning, in English.

The name of the series has also been changed. The meaning, of course, remains original.

One extra piece of news is that this game will soon receive another version, or a few versions, to add music to the story with Henry, after which it will be close to the final version, or finished! 
It's a long way from where I envision it.

Oh, and of course, as the income comes in, the translations, which are still automatic, will be revised.

Thank you for your understanding, and we hope that Sutelz's days get better and better! ✨✨

notes.title: KimiIre: Simplified Chinese and Spanish now also available!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, it is with great honor that I present this update to Kimi sae Ireba Episode Sutelz to add some languages, and below I explain a little about this decision.

The translation was done entirely by AI, where the base file was the original script, i.e. Brazilian Portuguese, since Spanish is very similar. I researched the likelihood of the translation not turning out well, and after confirming that it is possible to make it identical, along with some improvements in word variations, I decided that it could be added. 
If there are any problems with the translation, please report them in the Discussions tab. I don't know if it will be possible to fix it immediately, but I'll do what's in my control.

I've also added Simplified Chinese. I noticed that some people from China bought the game, but didn't play for much more than 10 minutes, so I made use of the AI for that too. Unfortunately, I've spent a lot of money on this game, because I'm alone, an ordinary person, and I haven't made any money yet, so I'm here trying to do something to boost the game, and if necessary, use the profits to finish it by improving the translations.

My thoughts on this are to add at least 10 different languages. In fact, not just this one, but the Visual Novel version of this “Kimi sae Ireba” series, it's my dream to add several languages!


Well, thank you very much for contributing your review and understanding the difficulties of maintaining this game!

We hope that Sutelz's days will be better!✨💛




Note: The DEMO version is not available for Spanish and Simplified Chinese.
